text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*, *pant*... Not yet, I can't win 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To win at the Kikuka Sho, I must become 
strong enough not to be fazed, no matter 
what trouble comes my way...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond strives in her training day 
after day for the Kikuka Sho. With each 
passing day, I can feel her senses growing 
sharper.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are no issues with the adjustments 
themselves. However, Satono Diamond felt 
terribly tense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially that line, "Possessing the 
strength to crush jinxes underfoot"—she 
repeats it often.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... whew!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, doing the uphill dashes has 
gotten quite easy for me now.
choice_data_list: Think you can handle two more sets?
Think you can handle two more sets?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For now, I'll try running one more 
extra rep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is my fixation on the jinx due to the 
weight of the Satono family's 
expectations? If so, then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Let's try asking “her” for help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you today, 
Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
M-M... McQueen-san?! McQueen-san, you're 
going to train together with me?!
choice_data_list:
There's a lot to learn from this, wouldn't 
you say?

There's a lot to learn from this, isn't 
there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! McQueen-san, thank you so much for 
this valuable opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there is no need to be so modest. It 
provides great inspiration for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, our time is limited. After 
warming up, let's do some light running. 
How about tandem running after that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah! Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... I was so close, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We fell too far behind in the first half. 
We must refine our tactical patterns 
further to match the front-runner's pace.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Thanks to you, I can now see 
what I'm lacking!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is wonderful to hear. Now then, 
to finish up, let us proceed to our 
roadwork as a cool-down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's expression is bright and 
radiant. There is no trace of tension in 
the air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that Mejiro McQueen, who shared 
a similar background, might understand 
Satono Diamond's feelings. Deciding to 
consult her was indeed the right choice."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Ah! I'm so sorry, 
McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A honey drink food truck! Um... would it 
be all right if I went and bought some?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you are quite right. Shall we take a 
hydration break here, then?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Satono-san, you certainly ordered quite 
a large size, didn't you...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this shop has a famous jinx, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Drinking an 'LL Honey Lemon, soft honey, 
extra rich, extra heavy' before a race 
jinxes you to lose!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I decided to deliberately drink this 
before the Kikuka Sho to break the jinx!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The jinx...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I got held back by jinxes in 
both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby)—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. And so, for the Kikuka Sho, 
you're carrying a stronger determination 
than ever to conquer that jinx.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I won't lose to any jinx! I'll prove 
it at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The mindset of training hard so as not to 
succumb to the jinx is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it because you treat bad luck as a 
jinx that you lose your composure?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In races, especially long-distance ones, 
it is vital to keep your composure and run 
your own race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If you get shaken, you'll lose focus, and 
the psychological burden will drain your 
stamina. You won't even be in any state to 
run your own race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have had a similar experience myself. 
Meeting with misfortune in an important 
race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san too... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring)...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...That race was an important one for 
me, with back-to-back victories on the 
line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Right before entering the gate, it felt as 
though my right leg caught on something. 
When I checked... I had thrown a shoe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am aware. A horseshoe was bent in 
half... and was reforged on the spot, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That's correct. Back then, I didn't think 
throwing a shoe was bad luck."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was focusing calmly on nothing but 
getting the horseshoe refitted. And then, 
the race began—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What I was watching, what I was thinking 
about, was neither the horseshoe on my 
right hoof, nor Teio-san, who was called 
my rival back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is run my own race to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I stayed true to my running style through 
all 3,200 meters. That is why I was able 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Focus only on my own running...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
During the Japanese Derby, my shoe broke, 
so I had to run in a spare. I couldn't 
stop worrying about it the entire race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't focus on the race at all, and 
couldn't run the way I wanted to. It's so 
frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. Had you not already noticed it 
yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I was conscious of it as a 
jinx, was I letting myself be trapped by 
the jinx...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I don't let the jinx get in my head, it 
won't hold me back...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I had never even considered that... 
But you do have a point..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I understand now why 
McQueen-san possesses such unwavering 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Because you always focus solely on your 
own running and goals... is that why you 
possess such dignified poise?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could you say she's truly grounded? Ehehe, 
McQueen-san really is amazing after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And besides... jinxes are usually made up 
after looking at the results anyway."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I had lost that race, people might have 
blamed it on the jinx. Yet if you win, no 
one speaks of jinxes at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that's true! Then, 
that jinx about losing a race if you drink 
this honey lemon must also be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that just because you gained weight 
from drinking it? It's clearly excess 
calories, and the lemon flavor likely 
masks how sweet it actually is."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Auugh... I-I drank it all...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-saaan!! To make up for the honey 
lemon... Please give me extra training~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I tried writing down all the 
challenges I need to overcome before the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Pacing for 3,000m, positioning research, 
race development simulations... I need 
more stamina too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We have a whole mountain of tasks we need 
to do! We don't have time to be distracted 
by jinxes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will perfect Satono Diamond's running! 
And we will undoubtedly seize victory in 
the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a bright and clear expression, Satono 
Diamond firmly pledged to win.
